page.overview:
What is Stitched Animatronics?

The Stitched animatronics are a set of merch-exclusive characters with stitched-up patchwork bodies, making them look like menacing stuffed animals. They have only been featured as stickers in the Five Nights at Freddy's Stickerpedia.

Stitched Freddy is a Freddy variant with a light and dark brown, and light and dark orange patchwork body. His eyes have white irises and he has sharp teeth, and wears a black top hat.

Stitched Bonnie is a Bonnie variant with a light and dark blue and black patchwork body. He has white eyes and sharp teeth, with a green tongue hanging out the side of his mouth. He also wears a red bowtie.

Stitched Chica is a Chica variant with a yellow and orange patchwork body. She has white eyes, sharp teeth, and a white bib that is stitched together but doesn't have any words on it.
